name: Luce
source:
A Lyurielf who holds the position of priest in the Fiushia Church.
After witnessing concerning activities from a faction of the Belgarad Kingdom, situated to the northwest of the Kingdom of Influs, she hurried to the Principality of Mephi to offer her assistance to Fia, the symbol of the Fiushia Church.
Certainly! Here's the rewritten text:
She was actually present when Avaro was born. It is said that she was one of the closest friends of Avaro's mother, Ruda when she was alive. As a result, she treats Avaro as if he were her own son and tries to spoil him whenever she gets the chance. Her affectionate ways are capable of ruining boys.
She has a calm and kind personality, but when she gets angry, she seems to have a habit of quietly cornering them without changing her expression.
